{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment is negative (sentiment < 0) to account for bearish bias.",
    "Reduce forecast overshoots following sharp price spikes by applying a 10-15% dampening factor to the immediate next period.",
    "Apply mean reversion correction: if forecast deviates > ±15% from 5-day moving average, adjust toward it.",
    "For sentiment > 0.5, increase forecast volatility slightly to reflect bullish momentum, but cap at +20% above baseline.",
    "When sentiment is stable (0.0–0.25), prioritize historical trend alignment over model extrapolation.",
    "Lag correction: if true outcome is significantly lower than forecast 3–5 days prior, reduce future forecasts by 5–10% to account for delayed market reaction.",
    "Avoid overreacting to single-day sentiment spikes — apply smoothing filter over 3-day sentiment window before adjusting forecasts."
  ]
}
